summary: Iteration 123 - Liquid Builder Kodee-Style UX Simplification Testing: All features working correctly. The new design is clean, light, mobile-first with clear drill-down navigation. All 4 tabs (Elements, Cards, Layout, Bot) work properly. Undo/Redo/Clear Draft/Save buttons functional. Page selector navigation works with 22 pages. Custom card CRUD and live card editing work with proper drill-down and back button.
seed_data_creation: Test custom cards created and cleaned up during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Liquid Builder Kodee-style redesign verified. All features working: 4 tabs (العناصر/الكروت/التخطيط/البوت), page selector with 22 pages, drill-down navigation with back button, Undo/Redo/Clear Draft/Save buttons, Canvas overlay toggle, Bot tab with quick actions and local commands. Mobile-first design with rounded corners and light theme.
